structured_output.summary: Pennsylvania taxes only the $1,675 of interest, at 3.07%, which gives $51.42 before credits. Social Security survivor benefits are not a PA taxable income class. The pension, 401(k) and IRA distributions to a 67-year-old retiree are excluded as old-age or retirement benefits. PA Tax Forgiveness (Schedule SP) is a nonrefundable credit, and its eligibility (poverty) income leaves out both retirement benefits and Social Security, per the statute and PA DOR. Eligibility income is therefore $1,675, under the $6,500 single threshold for 100% forgiveness, so the tax is $0. That matches the engine. The consensus of $51.42 leaves out Tax Forgiveness, apparently assuming Social Security or retirement income counts toward eligibility, which the law does not support.
